retrievalProfile.description: A composite band portrait featuring a group in the foreground against a brick wall mural of their younger selves.
triggerTerms: composite group photo with ghosted faces

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a group of men seated in the foreground, set against a weathered brick building that features a colorful, graffiti-style mural of faces. The image uses a dark, grounded color palette with a clear typographic header and footer.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground subjects anchored in a dark, solid base
Background mural providing a textured, colorful contrast
Top-aligned display text framed by horizontal lines
coreInvariants: The juxtaposition of current subjects against a mural of their past or alternate selves
A dark horizontal band at the bottom for grounding text
Industrial brick textures with multi-pane windows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The band is centered in the lower-middle ground, scaled to occupy about one-third of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, solid ground at the bottom of the frame acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large top header, moves down to the mural faces, rests on the central group, and finishes at the bottom-right text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark negative space is concentrated at the bottom and the right-hand side of the building structure.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Dark charcoal and black provide the foundation and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Terracotta red and brick tones provide the mid-ground texture.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted blues, yellows, and purples within the mural graffiti.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the dark foreground and the textured wall.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or overly bright primary colors

composition.relationshipToImage: Overlays the top edge of the building
Placed within the dark bottom band

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different weights and cases for consistency.
graphicDevices: Triple horizontal lines flanking the top header text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and clean lines of the era.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and uppercase impact.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of a group of men in dark suits sitting in front of a red brick industrial building. The building should have a colorful, faded mural of faces painted on it and several multi-pane windows. The bottom of the image should be a dark, shadowed pavement area.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large geometric sans-serif title in uppercase at the top center, flanked by three thin horizontal lines on each side. Add a smaller subtitle in the bottom right corner in white sentence-case text.

verificationChecks: Is the top text centered and flanked by lines?
Is the mural background textured and colorful but faded?
Is the bottom band dark enough to make white text legible?

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the group

mustAchieve: Clear separation between foreground subjects and background mural
avoid: Overly saturated mural colors that distract from the subjects
Modern digital filters that look artificial

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is perfectly horizontal and aligned.
Check that the mural faces do not look like AI artifacts.
Verify the lighting on the foreground subjects matches the environment.
Confirm the triple-line graphic device is present at the top.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a group portrait with a 'ghost of the past' mural background, framed by clean geometric sans-serif typography at the vertical extremes.
